E1 shows Pt stability on a high-entropy oxide support, not exsolution or self-regeneration. E2 discusses dopant effects on Pt reactivity in a different context (methanol oxidation), not exsolution or automotive exhaust conditions. Thus, the core mechanism and material-specific claims lack direct support.
